title: Second Hotbar
description: This mod allows you to quickly switch between two hotbars or slots.
body:
> <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/xE06zN-OlKk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>- Adds a second hotbar row linked to your 3rd inventory row. Press R(default) to swap your selected slot with the corresponding slot above. Simple, clean, no extra UI clutter.
